claims.content: Customer places a bid on an auction item.

scope_contract.goal_statement: Customer places a bid on an auction item.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: While viewing an auction item, the Customer submits a bid for that item and the bid is successfully placed.
scope_contract.start_boundary: The Customer has identified a specific auction item and decides to place a bid.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The Customer's bid has been placed on the auction item.
in_scope_actions: Place a bid on an auction item
excluded_adjacent_actions: Building or operating the auction platform
Payment or checkout after winning the auction

claims.content: Customer
The Customer is signed in and has provided the required minimum information required to bid.
The Customer has agreed to be bound by the Terms of Use Agreement.
The Customer has no unresolved (unpaid) auction winnings older than 7 days.
The Customer selects a bid amount and clicks the corresponding bid action button (e.g., 'QuickBid Now', 'Place SmartBid', or 'Place Single Bid') for the auction item.
The Customer selects a bid amount from the 'Your SmartBid' dropdown and clicks the 'Place SmartBid' button for the auction item.
The system displays a confirmation popup asking if the chosen bid is correct and identifying the credit card to be used.
The Customer confirms the bid by clicking the 'Yes, Place SmartBid' button in the confirmation popup.
After the Customer confirms the bid, the Customer remains on the product details page.
Diverges from Step 1: The Customer clicks the 'QuickBid Now' button to place a bid immediately without selecting a specific amount from a dropdown.
Diverges from Step 1: Instead of using the 'Your SmartBid' dropdown, the Customer selects a bid amount from the 'Single Bid' dropdown and clicks the 'Place Single Bid' button to submit the bid.

At main flow Step 1, if the Customer has unresolved (unpaid) auction winnings older than 7 days (168 hours), the system cancels the unpaid order and prevents the Customer from placing new bids. Exit: no bid is placed; the use case terminates.

At main flow Step 1, if the Customer has not signed in within the past 3 months and has not completed an auction purchase within that period, the system sends an authorization request ("ping") to the card on file to validate the card before allowing the Customer to bid. Exit: no bid is placed until validation succeeds; if validation fails, the outcome is undocumented.

At main flow Step 1, if the Customer's account is closed or suspended, the system displays a popup: "We're sorry, this account has been closed [suspended]. If you believe this is an error, please call or email Customer Care at (800) 123-4567 or Auctions@jtv.com." Exit: no bid is placed; the use case terminates.

At main flow Step 1, after a sign-in interruption, if the Customer has the required minimum information to bid, the system returns the Customer to the product details page of the item they initially tried to bid on. Exit: no bid is placed until the Customer returns to that page and re-submits the bid; if the required minimum information is missing, the outcome is undocumented.

At main flow Step 2, if the default payment method is an expired credit card on file, the system displays a prompt asking whether to update the card now. If the Customer chooses "Yes, update now", the system takes the Customer to My Account Edit page 3 to update the card; if the Customer chooses "No", the system returns the Customer to the home page and grays out the current page. Exit: the bid is not completed; the use case terminates or hands off to the card-update flow.

At alternative flow Step 1 (QuickBid), if the Customer is not signed in when clicking the QuickBid button, the system prompts the Customer to sign in and then returns the Customer to the catalog page. Exit: no bid is placed; the use case terminates.

missing_aspects: No evidence specifies what happens if the Customer cancels the bid confirmation popup in main flow Step 2.
For the expired-credit-card branch, no evidence specifies whether the Customer returns to the bid confirmation after updating the card, and the "I'll do it later" option's navigation is undocumented.
For the 3-month card validation, no evidence specifies failure handling if the card authorization request fails.
For a sign-in interruption, no evidence documents the outcome if the Customer lacks the required minimum information.
For the account-closed/suspended branch, evidence documents the popup and sign-in block but not the exit behavior for an already-in-progress bid attempt.

claims.content: The Customer's bid has been placed on the auction item.
The system keeps the Customer on the product details page for the auction item.
